research_rationale: Identity: the held Federal Register text (jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_11417.txt; 33 FR 10625, PDF page 5 of the issue of Friday, July 26, 1968) is Executive Order 11417, whose printed heading adds an Assistant Secretary of Commerce to the membership of the Development Loan Committee. The held text prints the signing date only as "July 1968."; the census register row gives 1968-07-24, and the same page carries a Federal Register filing line dated July 25, 1968. Inventory: the order is one operative paragraph, and it is the whole order. It further amends Executive Order No. 10973 of November 3, 1961, as amended, by inserting in section 305, after the Assistant Secretary of the Treasury dealing with international finance, the Assistant Secretary of Commerce for Domestic and International Business. The held text of Executive Order 10973 (jobs/fr-originals/output/texts/EO_10973.txt) shows that section 305 establishes the Development Loan Committee and lists its members. The text that follows the order on the held PDF pages (Commerce regulations at 33 FR 10627) belongs to other documents. End: Executive Order 12163 (signed September 29, 1979; 44 FR 56673; held text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12163.txt) provides in section 1-903(a)(1) that "Executive Order No. 10973 of November 3,1961, as amended;" is revoked, and in section 1-905 that "The provisions of this order shall become effective as of" October 1, 1979 (the text then reads "October 1,1979."). The insertion made by this order exists only as words inside section 305 of the parent order; under the owner ruling of 2026-10-21 on strike-and-insert amendments the clause therefore continues, amended, until the parent ends. Executive Order 12163 is also not a cleanup revocation. Its section 1-505 re-establishes a Development Loan Committee, stated to be "in accordance with section 122(e)" of the Act, with a new list of members that names the Assistant Secretary of Commerce for Industry and Trade and does not name the office this order inserted, so from October 1, 1979 the old list in section 305 and the insertion in it have no continuing text. The first end is recorded as the effective date, October 1, 1979; the clause was last in force on September 30, 1979. The Office of the Federal Register catalog note for this order (jobs/later-events/output/CATALOG_INDEX.csv) reads "Revoked by: EO 12163, September 29, 1979"; it gives the signing date of Executive Order 12163, and the effective date in section 1-905 is October 1, 1979. The catalog note for Executive Order 10973 carries the same revocation by Executive Order 12163. Earlier ends: none shown. This order states no duration of its own. The dossier lists later amenders of the parent: Executive Orders 11579, 11685, 11816, 11841, 11959 and 12118, and the catalog note for the parent also lists Executive Orders 11261, 11432 and 12107 as amending it. I searched the held text of each for the number 305, for the word Loan and for the word Committee. Executive Orders 11261 (section 304), 11432 (section 301), 11579, 11685, 11816, 11959 and 12118 contain no occurrence; Executive Order 12107 mentions only a list of orders in which the Civil Service Commission is replaced and does not mention section 305; Executive Order 11841 (held only as an American Presidency Project text, which I do not cite) adds a new section 306 for a Development Coordination Committee and does not mention section 305. A Cruden search of the held order texts for the phrase Development Loan Committee finds it only in Executive Orders 10742, 10973, 11417 and 12163 and in the Statutes at Large text of section 204 of the Foreign Assistance Act (75 Stat. 424). I also searched the held text of Public Law 93-189 (87 Stat. 714) for the words Development Loan and Loan Com and found no hit. No held source shows that the Committee or the order's insertion ended before October 1, 1979. Not claimed: whether the Committee continued to meet or to rest on section 204 or section 122(e) of the Foreign Assistance Act between 1973 and 1979 is not shown by a held statute text; the claim rests on the express text of section 305 as amended, which stood until revoked. Bounded search: the dossier's three machine searches (U.S. Code release point 119-121 through 2026-10-09; eCFR and GovInfo CFR bulk through 2026-10-14; Federal Register catalog disposition notes), chosen after reading their coverage notes, which carry no coverage warning, with the by-number and phrase scans above. AI producer hypothesis only; not human certification.
savings_reason: Executive Order 12163 section 1-904 begins "Except to the extent inconsistent with this order, all" delegations, determinations and other actions made before the order and not revoked continue in force until amended, modified or terminated by appropriate authority; this saves completed actions, not the old section 305 membership list. Membership of the Development Loan Committee moves to the new list in section 1-505 of Executive Order 12163, so the effect transfers to that provision.
earlier_end_check: Own terms: the order states no duration, condition or end. Later instruments: Executive Orders 11579, 11685, 11816, 11959 and 12118 were searched in their held Federal Register texts for 305, Development Loan and Committee, with no hit, so none touches section 305 or this insertion. Executive Order 11579 section 4(d) supersedes Executive Order No. 10973 only insofar as a provision of the parent conflicts with a provision of that order, and that order's text does not mention the Development Loan Committee, so no conflict with section 305 is shown and it is not an end. Executive Order 11841 adds a different section, 306. The three machine searches report no U.S. Code or eCFR hit and list only the Federal Register catalog notes already reconciled above. The first end is the express revocation of the parent order, as amended, by Executive Order 12163, effective October 1, 1979, together with that order's replacement membership list in section 1-505.
scope_check: One clause is inventoried: the single operative paragraph that amends section 305 of Executive Order No. 10973. The authority recital, the title and the signature block are not commands. The insertion continues until the parent's section 305 ends; Executive Order 12163 revokes the parent order in full by number, as amended.
independent_command_check: The insertion creates no command, fund, delegation or appointment independent of section 305 of the parent order; it only changes a list of committee members inside that section, so nothing in it outlives the section.
savings_check: Executive Order 12163 sections 1-903, 1-904 and 1-905 were read. Section 1-904 begins "Except to the extent inconsistent with this order, all" earlier delegations, determinations and other actions continue until amended, modified or terminated; it preserves actions already taken, not the old membership list, which section 1-505 replaces.
